convert_lcm_checkpoint: convert an LCM checkpoint by removing the module. prefix from DDP state dict keys
load_base_lcm_config: load a BaseLCModelConfig using the StandardModelConfigLoader for the base LCM model family
load_base_lcm_model: load a base LCM model using the StandardModelLoader with checkpoint conversion and config loading
register_lcm_model_loader: register the base LCM model loader with fairseq2 load_model for the BASE_LCM_MODEL_TYPE family
register_lcm_model_type: register a ModelTypeConfig for the base LCM model type in the lcm_model_type_registry
